items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: they had like the King Sisters there.

ctx.x: This out -- I'm glad, I want you to explain this place, how it looked, Budd. Explain it.

Oh, it was a dream. They had lights and all, like Christmas lights, and everything, all in the trees. They had gondolas where here come this boss out with his secretary. He could get on the boat like you're in Venice, and the cat would sing to you and row you to your little house where you could have sexual intercourse with the girl, and they come back into the club, and they had like the King Sisters there. They had like all of these foreign people with their shows, and they would bring in their music, and we…
Like we -- we weren't playing all those instruments,
